name: Kimberly Rae Coaching: setter phone call
sources: KRC - Master Setting Doc (outbound dial, application/quiz leads)
Kimberly Rae Chapman Phone Setting Script (fresh opt-ins)
rules: Dial within 5 to 10 minutes of opt-in; double dial; voicemail and text only after the second miss.
Do not quote program prices or payment plans. Range anchor allowed: low to mid four figures.
Financing route: credit 650+ or DQ (Master Setting Doc).
Default to a live transfer when possible.
Book only after the lead accepts the calendar invite on the phone.

checks.text: Confirms who they're speaking to and introduces self as Kimberly's team
Anchors to what the lead did (application, quiz, training, DM)
Explains the purpose (point them in the right direction)
Gets permission to ask a few questions
Biggest thing not working in dating/relationships
Digs in: what does that look like, how long
Relationship status / background
What they've tried and how it went
Doubt: what's getting in the way
Why now
Cost of the problem, spillover into life
Desired picture if solved
Reflects their situation back in one line
Sells the consultation call (worst case clarity, best case changes it)
Asks if they can invest if it's the right fit
Uses only the range anchor (low to mid four figures); no specific prices or plans
Handles hesitation with the resourcefulness reframe or financing/credit check
Offers a live transfer or two specific times
Confirms timezone and email
Has them accept the calendar invite while on the phone
Gets their word to reschedule rather than no-show
Quiet place, present, not driving
Connects them to the closer (intro text) and/or sends the pre-call video
